Welcome to Dark Willow Crypt

Explore the remote grounds of Dark Willow Crypt in search of legendary magical secrets from the mages laid to rest there. But the dead do not give up their secrets freely... With rogue-like, survivor style game-play, face the graveyard's increasingly challenging guardians while enhancing your own magical abilities through both the artifacts you find and the experience you gain.

Game-play Features

  • First-Person arena shooter combat with Survivor-genre inspired mechanics

  • Rogue-like leveling system with a variety of player and weapon upgrades for diverse build crafting

  • A handcrafted magical world with varied arenas to provide unique combat challenges and distinct enemy encounters

  • Optional Endless-Mode to push player builds to their absolute limit
